# Design decision — approved

Author response: “yes approve, but the name should be play to win dont play not to lose”.

Title: **Play to Win, Don’t Play Not to Lose**.

Review `PROJECT_BOARD.html`, `previews/PROJECT_BOARD.png` or `previews/PROJECT_BOARD.pdf` for the updated v02 board.

- Direction: jade / ivory / brass, eight-bamboo tile offered across a table.
- Typography and scene style: editorial serif with geometric, textured composition studies.
- Artifact: “Đổi góc nhìn”, a qualitative before/after beliefs matrix.
- Book number: **06**, approved with the design. The original source heading remains 5; live 05 is For Mother Russia.

Decision: **approved with title correction, applied throughout the board and metadata**. The working manuscript has the authorized new heading; all 41 body paragraphs and the original attachment remain unchanged. Exact source quotations keep their original wording.

Approval covers this visual direction and the next production pass. Publishing is a separate later decision.
